basicSetup.title: Setup and Core Loop
basicSetup.description: Start from the real character select screen and learn the basic pre-haunt entry points.

steps.selectExplorer: Start by choosing an explorer on the real character select screen. This is not a tutorial-only page.
steps.confirmStart: Use this button to confirm your explorer. Once confirmed, the match continues through the normal opening flow.
steps.startScenario: When everyone is ready, start the real first scenario from the same entry point.
steps.runtimeOverview: These five buttons are the core runtime actions: move, explore, trade, use, and end turn.
steps.inventoryAndHelp: The lower-left area is your real inventory. Tap a card to zoom it. The reference card is only a help entry, not the main UI.
steps.roomBoard: The central room board is the main play area. Read this first, then decide where to move or explore.
steps.finish: This chapter only locks the real entry points. The next short chapters cover move, explore, use, and the first haunt goal.

moveExploreUse.title: Move, Explore, and Use
moveExploreUse.description: Walk through one real pre-haunt sequence of using an item, moving, and exploring.

steps.setupRuntime: The next steps jump into a real pre-haunt runtime state for the first scenario.
steps.useRope: Use the rope first. It grants extra movement so you can keep the room exploration going.
steps.moveToGrandStaircase: Now move to the Grand Staircase. Green targets are real reachable rooms, not tutorial overlays.
steps.exploreUpper: Then use Explore to reveal the next room. Exploration really triggers an event, item, or omen.
steps.finish: You have now walked through a real use -> move -> explore sequence. That is the normal runtime rhythm.

crimsonJack.title: Crimson Jack Objective
crimsonJack.description: Explain what the heroes and the traitor are trying to do once the first haunt begins.

steps.setupHaunt: This chapter jumps directly into a real haunt state for the first scenario.
steps.hauntReveal: The first haunt is Crimson Jack Returns. Once the haunt starts, the revealer becomes the traitor.
steps.heroGoal: The hero line has three goals: learn about Jack, study two exorcism circles, then banish Jack's Spirit.
steps.traitorGoal: The traitor wants to kill the heroes, or return to life through Jack's Spirit. The board and actions stay on the same real page.
steps.finish: You should now understand that this haunt is driven by investigation, circles, and Jack's Spirit, not just combat.

hauntActions.title: Haunt Actions and Finish
hauntActions.description: Use a real endgame-ready haunt state to review help, haunt actions, and the true finish.

steps.setupReadyToExorcise: This chapter jumps to a real state where the heroes are ready to finish the exorcism.
steps.helpEntry: If you need to re-read the printed aid, open it here. The help entry stays lightweight and does not replace the action bar.
steps.hauntActions: The haunt-specific actions still live in the real bottom action row: learn, study, exorcise, and attack when needed.
steps.exorciseJack: Execute the real exorcise action now. A success leads straight into the actual endgame screen.
steps.endgameReview: This is the real hero-side finish for the first scenario, not a tutorial-only end screen.
